ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Via Windows Defender MpCmpRun.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Windows Defender MpCmdRun.EXE to download files

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "MpCmdRun\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MpCmdRun\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MpCmdRun\\\.exe.*") OR process_description = "Microsoft\ Malware\ Protection\ Command\ Line\ Utility") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*DownloadFile.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*url.*")))
